Titles with markup characters are escaped with a backslash: [[C\# notes]], [[a\|b]], [[Q3 \[draft\]]] and [[trailing\\]].

An alias with brackets: [[Penmoss — product brief|x\]\]y]]. A heading keeps its hashes: [[Penmoss — MCP tools#Tools#Write \[beta\]|write \| tools]].

A backslash before an ordinary character stays as written: [[C:\Users\notes]].

| Link | Note |
| - | - |
| [[a\\\|b\|alias]] | pipe in the title, then the alias |
| [[trailing\\\\\|t]] | backslash at the end of the title |
| [[C\# notes\|C#]] | hash in the title, not in the alias |
